question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

 LOQUACIOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Loquacious"** means someone who tends to talk a lot or is very talkative. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** She is so loquacious that she can hold a conversation for hours without pausing.
 
 
• **"Talkative"** refers to a person who enjoys talking and speaks freely and frequently. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The talkative child kept sharing stories with everyone at the party.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Loquacious'** is **'Talkative'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Refers to someone who is silent or speaks very little.
 
 
• **Example:** The quiet room was perfect for studying without interruptions.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (संकोची): Refers to someone who is introverted and keeps to themselves.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being reserved, he opened up once he got to know the group.
 
 
 
• **Taciturn** (मितभाषी): Refers to someone who is naturally quiet and speaks very little.
 
 
• **Example:** John was a taciturn man who preferred listening rather than talking.
